_about: Public-domain Edward Williams (1750-1813), Welsh Congregationalist divine and tutor of Rotherham Academy, for the Word Hoard: Antipaedobaptism Examined (2 vols, Shrewsbury 1789) and An Essay on the Equity of Divine Government and the Sovereignty of Divine Grace (1809), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 49 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
